blocks.text: Optimizing your research librarian workflow on Mac

Your day as a research librarian involves moving between many different browser tabs, citation managers, and communication tools. You might start your morning in Zotero to organize new sources, then move to a web browser to search through academic databases. The constant switching between these environments creates cognitive friction. Lazur simplifies this by acting as your constant assistant.

When you need to find a specific setting in a complex research app, you do not need to hunt through menus. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where it is. Lazur will draw a circle on your screen to highlight the exact location. This works in any app, whether you are using Zotero, Bookends, or a browser-based database.
Managing academic database management tools efficiently

The core of your work is gathering information. You spend significant time developing and testing search strings for systematic reviews. This is a technical process that requires precision. If you get stuck on a specific syntax or need to recall a complex boolean operator, just ask Lazur. Lazur can explain the logic behind your search strings, helping you refine your queries without leaving your current workspace.
Reducing administrative drift in your daily schedule

Librarians face high administrative loads. You likely spend over a quarter of your week on email and communication. This leaves less time for deep research. Lazur helps you reclaim this time. Use the fn key to dictate your responses to emails or to draft instructional handouts. Because Lazur handles the typing, you can keep your hands on your keyboard and your eyes on your research materials.

blocks.text: Common research librarian challenges and solutions

One common mistake is losing context when switching between tasks. You might be in the middle of a literature review when an urgent request comes in. By using Lazur to manage your notes and reminders, you can quickly offload that task and return to your research. Lazur keeps a memory of your recent interactions, so you can easily pick up where you left off.

Always follow your institution's policies regarding sensitive patron data or proprietary research materials. Lazur processes information locally and does not store your screenshots or audio, but you are responsible for the content you handle.
blocks.title: A note on institutional compliance

faq.question: Can Lazur interact with my citation manager?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot directly edit your Zotero or Bookends library. However, it can guide you through the interface, point out menu items, and help you draft notes or emails related to your citations.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with offline academic databases?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works with any application on your Mac, regardless of whether it requires an internet connection. It sees your screen and provides guidance based on what is visible.

faq.question: Is my research data private?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your audio or screen images. The information is processed to provide an answer and then discarded. Your data is never used to train AI models.
